desc: List the event names in a perf.data file
doc: perf-evlist - List the event names in a perf.data file
This command displays the names of events sampled in a perf.data file.

<dl><dt data-o="">-i, --input=</dt><dd>Input file name. (default: perf.data unless stdin is a fifo)</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-f, --force</dt><dd>Don’t complain, do it.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-F, --freq=</dt><dd>Show just the sample frequency used for each event.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-v, --verbose</dt><dd>Show all fields.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-g, --group</dt><dd>Show event group information.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">--trace-fields</dt><dd>Show tracepoint field names.</dd></dl>
